name: science-academy
description: Runs the backend (Express + MySQL) and frontend (website) together from the root folder.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit
